parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6", "max_tokens": 512, "system": "You are a CRM data-extraction engine...", "tools": [{ "name": "record_lead", "input_schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "full_name": {"type":["string","null"]}, "email": {"type":["string","null"]}, "location": {"type":["string","null"]}, "budget": {"type":["string","null"]}, "vehicle_interest": {"type":["string","null"]}, "purchase_timeline": {"type":["string","null"]}, "financing_need": {"type":["boolean","null"]}, "trade_in_interest": {"type":["boolean","null"]} } } }], "tool_choice": { "type": "tool", "name": "record_lead" }, "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": $('Render Transcript').item.json.text }] } }}

parameters.query: UPDATE leads SET full_name=COALESCE($1,full_name), email=COALESCE($2,email), location=COALESCE($3,location), budget=COALESCE($4,budget), vehicle_interest=COALESCE($5,vehicle_interest), purchase_timeline=COALESCE($6,purchase_timeline), financing_need=COALESCE($7,financing_need), trade_in_interest=COALESCE($8,trade_in_interest), score=$9, temperature=$10, conversion_probability=$11, sentiment=$12, intent_summary=$13, status=$14 WHERE id = (SELECT lead_id FROM calls WHERE id = $15);

nodes.name: Upsert Lead
nodes.notes: Bind params $1..$15 from Score Lead output (fields.*, score, temperature, conversion_probability, summary.sentiment, summary.key_intent, status, call_id).
